content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date for email application is 30 August 2026, and the walk-in interview is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Ensure all documents are ready by these dates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Project Assistant position is Graduation. Candidates should ensure they meet this requirement before applying.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 40 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST, OBC, and PWD candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 22,000/- plus HRA per month for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ICAR IARI Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required original documents and self-attested copies on the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at the ICAR IARI office in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110012.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the ICAR IARI Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates if any), and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position is based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job for the Project Assistant position at ICAR IARI.
